title_translit: Sadguru Jivandasji Maharajni Punya Sthalio Vishe Sankshipt Parichay
title_en: A brief introduction to the sacred places of Sadguru Jivandasji Maharaj
translation:
Ramkabir

A brief introduction to the sacred places of Sadguru Jivandasji Maharaj

The places on earth where holy souls have wandered become joyous through the blessed presence of these great beings. The air is fragrant with the resonance of the holy one's words. An atmosphere polluted by worldly attachment and aversion becomes fragrant instead with love, goodwill, knowledge, and devotion. The experience of this fragrance goes on stirring every particle for a long time afterward. A visit (darshan) to these places is purifying. It awakens in the visitor a sense of wonder: "My Beloved dwelt right here." It shakes one's own unconsciousness awake and inspires the awakened consciousness to walk the path of the divine.

Divine souls keep coming into the world for the welfare of people. Their arrival happens when the smoke of attachment and aversion thickens, when people abandon the way of even-sightedness and, acting out of self-interest, do things they should not do, building up this world while forgetting the world to come.

These sacred places are like lamps that give true guidance to travellers wandering in darkness.

_Dhan dhan re Jamuna tat, dhan Vrajno re vaas. Param bhagya aa bhumina, vahalo ramiya chhe raas._ (Blessed, blessed is the bank of the Yamuna, blessed is the abode of Vraj — supremely fortunate is this land, for the Beloved played the raas dance here.)

Narsinh Mehta praises such a land in this way.

Let us now become acquainted with the sacred places of the Uda faith, and let us feel fulfilled through the experience of their darshan.
